key.name: hide-activities
key.summary: Hide the Activities / workspace indicator

key.name: clock-on-right
key.summary: Move the clock (date menu) to the far right, macOS-style

key.name: fullscreen-reveal
key.summary: Reveal the panel at the top edge while an app is fullscreen

key.name: notification-center-enabled
key.summary: Open the Tahoe-style Notification Center from the clock

key.name: notification-center-widgets
key.summary: Ordered identifiers of widgets shown in Notification Center

key.name: notification-center-widget-sizes
key.summary: Notification Center widget sizes: small, medium, or large

key.name: weather-provider
key.summary: Weather service used by the Notification Center widget

key.name: weather-location-mode
key.summary: Where the weather location comes from
key.description: auto uses Location Services and falls back to weather-location when they are off or fail; manual always uses weather-location.

key.name: weather-location
key.summary: Chosen weather city: name, latitude, longitude, IANA time zone

key.name: weather-units
key.summary: Temperature unit: follow the region, Celsius or Fahrenheit

key.name: show-system-menu
key.summary: Show the left-hand system (Apple-style) menu

key.name: system-menu-icon
key.summary: System-menu logo: an emoji/symbol glyph, an icon-theme name, or a file path; empty = the distributor logo from os-release LOGO=

key.name: show-active-app
key.summary: Show the focused application's name

key.name: empty-app-label
key.summary: Text shown when no window is focused (empty = hide)

key.name: control-center-mode
key.summary: custom = separate Wi-Fi, battery and Control Center menus; native = open Quick Settings

key.name: control-center-controls
key.summary: Ordered identifiers of the controls shown in the custom Control Center
key.description: Grid controls are laid out in this order; display, sound and microphone are the sliders below the grid, in their relative order.

key.name: control-center-control-sizes
key.summary: Control Center control sizes: small (a circle), wide, or large

key.name: clock-show-weekday
key.summary: Show weekday in the clock

key.name: clock-date-mode
key.summary: Show the date in the clock: when space allows, always, or never

key.name: clock-show-ampm
key.summary: Show AM/PM after the time (12-hour mode only)

key.name: clock-show-seconds
key.summary: Show seconds in the clock

key.name: appearance
key.summary: Panel background style

key.name: overview-mode
key.summary: How the Lintel bar behaves in the Overview

key.name: text-mode
key.summary: Text/icon colour: auto (sample visible background), light, or dark

key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Panel height in px (0 = inherit theme; macOS Tahoe is 24)

key.name: h-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding of panel buttons in px (-1 = inherit; macOS Tahoe is 10)

key.name: item-spacing
key.summary: Horizontal spacing between panel items in px (-1 = inherit)

key.name: font-size-pt
key.summary: Font size in pt (0 = inherit; 10.5pt = the 14px macOS menu bar text)

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family override; empty = Cantarell

key.name: font-weight
key.summary: Font weight override (e.g. normal, bold, 600); empty = inherit. macOS emphasises only the app title, so the bar itself is normal

key.name: hover-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the hover wash on panel buttons

key.name: active-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the active/open wash on panel buttons

key.name: show-menu-background
key.summary: Show the rounded background when a panel button is open

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the hover/active wash in px (high = pill)

key.name: transition-ms
key.summary: Hover/press transition duration in ms
